item.title: Everest Forms Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection to RCE (CVE-2026-3296)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-3296. Status: PoC (functional two-phase injection/trigger tool; RCE requires supplying a real POP gadget chain via PHPGGC). Affects: Everest Forms (WordPress plugin — Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder). Tags: wordpress, everest-forms, php-object-injection, deserialization, unserialize, rce, cwe-502.
